quarterly_data.quarter: SK Hynix press release: "Behind AI's Rapid Growth Lies Memory" - SK hynix Shares (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: SK hynix and TSMC carried out a collaboration that validated HBM5 on the basis of TSMC's CoWoS, with SK hynix's Package Development organization and TSMC validating together from the earliest stages (recognised at the TSMC OIP Conference on the 23rd). At the event SK hynix displayed NVIDIA's Vera Rubin superchip equipped with its 12-layer 36GB HBM4 and 96GB SOCAMM2, alongside the 12-layer 48GB HBM4E, 16-layer 48GB HBM4, 12-layer 36GB HBM3E and a 192GB SOCAMM2.
quarterly_data.figure: HBM5 validated on TSMC CoWoS; Vera Rubin with 12-layer 36GB HBM4 and 96GB SOCAMM2

quarterly_data.quarter: SK Hynix press release: "Behind AI's Rapid Growth Lies Memory" - SK hynix Shares (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: SK hynix (Daesik Park, distinguished engineer in PCIe Design, presenting with Cadence): "As AI infrastructure expands, the PCIe-based eSSD market is expected to grow roughly 3.8 times, from 509EB in 2026 to 1,933EB in 2030", with demand for E1.S and E3 form factors also rising rapidly. SK hynix has developed SSD controllers on TSMC processes since PCIe Gen3 and, for PCIe Gen6 and Gen7, is preparing chiplet-based SSD solutions that split the controller into chiplets connected via UCIe. The PS1101 E3.S shown is SK hynix's first QLC-based eSSD; the PEB210 E1.S supports direct liquid cooling.
quarterly_data.figure: PCIe eSSD market 509EB (2026) to 1,933EB (2030), roughly 3.8 times
